idea-plugin.name: Plagx Writing Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Free academic writing checks for essays, theses and papers written in Markdown, plain text or LaTeX: citations and reference lists, BibTeX files, word limits, basic grammar and punctuation, and writing readiness.

Features

  • Draft checks as you type in .md, .txt and .tex files: in-text citations with no reference entry, references never cited, word limits, punctuation, repeated words, a/an, sentence capitals, long sentences and required headings. Many suggestions have a quick fix (Alt+Enter).
  • Writing readiness in the status bar: word count, reading time, and Ready / Not ready.
  • BibTeX: duplicate entries, missing authors, titles and years, and invalid DOIs are highlighted in .bib files. Format a .bib file as an APA reference list or MLA Works Cited page.
  • Insert Reference from DOI: formatted reference, in-text or narrative citation.

Commands are in Tools | Plagx. Settings: Settings | Tools | Plagx Writing Companion (APA or MLA, word limits, required headings, checks, file types).

All checks run locally; your text is never uploaded. Only Insert Reference from DOI and the online DOI check contact the public Crossref API.

By Plagiarism Checker X. For full plagiarism checks and AI-generated text detection, visit Text Similarity Detector. This free plugin does not detect plagiarism or AI-generated text.
